memory_snapshot.method: memory_pressure(1) + vm_stat(1) + sysctl vm.swapusage, read live -- not inferred from chip name
memory_snapshot.note: swap usage reflects historically-swapped pages from long-running host processes (Antigravity, Claude Code, Docker Desktop, browsers); memory_pressure's free-percentage metric (accounts for reclaimable/compressed memory) is the more reliable live indicator than raw vm_stat free pages, but swap headroom (724MB free) is a real, independently binding constraint.
